item.title: [ZEPPELIN-2105] Yarn causes build failure when nodejs is not installed in local system
item.description:
yarn installed by frontend-maven-plugin causes build failure at `npm-run-all ...`

To reproduce this bug

  • remove nodejs and npm
  • mvn -X clean package -pl 'zeppelin-web' -DskipTests;

See also: https://github.com/eirslett/frontend-maven-plugin/issues/562
item.summary: Yarn causes build failure when nodejs is not installed in local system

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

GitHub user 1ambda opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/2016

ZEPPELIN-2105 yarn installed by frontend-maven-plugin causes build failure (BUG)

      1. What is this PR for?

yarn installed by frontend-maven-plugin causes build failure *when there is no nodeJS in local system*

To reproduce this bug

  • Remove system nodejs
  • Execute `mvn -X clean package -pl 'zeppelin-web' -DskipTests;`
        1. Details.
  • yarn installed by frontend-maven-plugin can't run commands described in scripts tag (`package.json`)
  • but npm is able to execute them.
  • so, it's bug of the maven plugin.
      1. What type of PR is it?
        [Bug Fix]
      1. Todos
  • [x] - Rollback yarn to npm
  • [x] - Update README.md for zeppelin-web
      1. What is the Jira issue?

ZEPPELIN-2105(https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/ZEPPELIN-2105)

      1. How should this be tested?
  • Remove system nodejs
  • `mvn -X clean package -pl 'zeppelin-web' -DskipTests;`
      1. Screenshots (if appropriate)

NONE

  • Does the licenses files need update? - NO
  • Is there breaking changes for older versions? - NO
  • Does this needs documentation? - NO
